items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-25
items.q: I suppose I made friends with a lot of people. But, Marcy and Tee Wee and,

ctx.x: I'll have to make it and play music, talk more with people and I find it's a good seat. So when Natalie was playing, he was playing, I was at the... I was playing my clarinet, same keys of trouble, but he didn't. Same keys of violin. Old shops and old flats. What about George like that? I would, a lot of him, I have a picture of him taking a job. Do you have a picture of yourself? Yeah, I remember Glenn, him, Bonk, me, him, Bonk, Marsman, Riley, Jim, and Dre, Elton, Mr. Tran, we played at the Academy of Music in…

Well, sometimes on those older records, they don't play 4-4, they play... What is it? Double record. Boy, at the night, there was a lot of people. Frank...
